attributes.board_name: New Mexico State Board of Psychologist Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I (min 15 hours): monitored group programs approved by an accredited graduate institution or certified/recognized by APA, American Psychiatric Association, AMA, AAMFT, ACA, International Congress of Psychology, NASW, NM Psychological Association, NASP or the NM Board; graduate courses (5 CPE per semester credit); monitored online courses. Remaining hours Category I or II
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CPE during the initial licensing period, but 8 hours of Board-approved cultural awareness coursework (cultures of New Mexico) before the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Board may audit; keep detailed CPE records for 2 years after the reporting period.

topics.who: All licensees: cultural diversity or health disparities
All licensees: equity and inclusion (race, ethnicity, systemic racism, structural inequality, poverty, marginalized communities)
Newly licensed psychologists and psychologist associates: NM cultural awareness coursework

rules.notes: Biennial renewal on or before July 1 of alternate years. Same rule for psychologist associates. Board service: up to 20 hours (counts as ethics); advanced certification/diplomate up to 15 hours.
rules.rule_quote: The board requires 40 hours of CPE for licensed psychologists and psychologist associates during every two years.

Conditional and unrestricted prescribing psychologists: psychopharmacology or psychopharmacotherapy

rules.notes: 60 hours every two years, of which 40 in psychopharmacology/psychopharmacotherapy. Biennial renewal on or before July 1 of alternate years.
rules.rule_quote: For conditional prescribing and unrestricted prescribing psychologists the board requires 60 hours of CPE every two years.
